_note: Paper cut at the end of a printed receipt (escPosLayoutBytes option `cut`): missing = default = `true` = `"full"` (five empty lines, then GS V 0), `"partial"` (five empty lines, then GS V 1), `false` (neither: the bytes end with the last line of the receipt). A case names a golden layout under expected/<receipt>.lines.json (with `paperSize` replacing its paper size); every other print option is the default. expected/print-cut.<name>.hex holds the bytes (32 bytes per line). Both registers set the cut per device (`cut`: partial, full, none). Written by `npm run fixtures:schnitt`.
